chose: toggle chips (Favourites, Skip recent) rendered as Button variant=outline aria-pressed, not the Switch primitive
over: components/ui/switch.tsx for the on/off filter chips
because: switch.tsx's own doc reserves Switch for persistent settings ('keep the screen awake'), not filter toggles; DetailPane's existing Favorite button already uses the same Button+aria-pressed pattern for an identical on/off action, so this keeps one visual grammar for 'toggleable filter' across the app

chose: single-select filter chips (meal type, max time, cuisine) built from DropdownMenu + DropdownMenuRadioGroup
over: the Popover primitive, and a hand-rolled absolute-positioned menu
because: spec explicitly allows popover OR dropdown-menu; DropdownMenuRadioGroup/RadioItem gives free aria-expanded, roving focus, escape-to-close and a checked-item indicator that a hand-rolled div would need reimplementing
